examples.hanzi: 这家书店有很多拉丁文的老书。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā shūdiàn yǒu hěn duō Lādīngwén de lǎo shū.
examples.english: This bookstore has many old books in Latin.

examples.hanzi: 他的老师是个会说拉丁语的历史学家。
examples.pinyin: Tā de lǎoshī shì gè huì shuō Lādīngyǔ de lìshǐxuéjiā.
examples.english: His teacher is a historian who can speak Latin.

examples.hanzi: 小心点,别让你的感冒传染给孩子。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn diǎn, bié ràng nǐ de gǎnmào chuánrǎn gěi háizi.
examples.english: Be careful not to pass your cold on to the kids.

examples.hanzi: 这种病不会传染,你不用害怕。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bìng bú huì chuánrǎn, nǐ bú yòng hàipà.
examples.english: This illness isn't contagious, so you needn't be afraid.

examples.hanzi: 我弟弟参加了童子军,周末常去露营。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi cānjiāle tóngzǐjūn, zhōumò cháng qù lùyíng.
examples.english: My younger brother joined the Scouts and often goes camping on weekends.

examples.hanzi: 童子军教会了孩子们怎么生火和打结。
examples.pinyin: Tóngzǐjūn jiàohuìle háizimen zěnme shēnghuǒ hé dǎjié.
examples.english: The Scouts taught the children how to light a fire and tie knots.

examples.hanzi: 下个星期我休假,哪儿也不去。
examples.pinyin: Xià gè xīngqī wǒ xiūjià, nǎr yě bú qù.
examples.english: I'm on leave next week and won't go anywhere.

examples.hanzi: 他在休假期间还是回了很多工作邮件。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xiūjià qījiān háishi huíle hěn duō gōngzuò yóujiàn.
examples.english: He still answered lots of work emails while on vacation.

examples.hanzi: 火灾发生后,大楼里的人员迅速撤离。
examples.pinyin: Huǒzāi fāshēng hòu, dàlóu lǐ de rényuán xùnsù chèlí.
examples.english: After the fire broke out, the people in the building evacuated quickly.

examples.hanzi: 军队已经从那个城市撤离了。
examples.pinyin: Jūnduì yǐjīng cóng nàge chéngshì chèlí le.
examples.english: The army has already withdrawn from that city.

examples.hanzi: 你摔了一跤,不要紧吧?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuāile yì jiāo, bú yàojǐn ba?
examples.english: You took a fall; it's nothing serious, right?

examples.hanzi: 这点小事不要紧,明天再说也行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn xiǎoshì bú yàojǐn, míngtiān zài shuō yě xíng.
examples.english: This little matter isn't urgent; it's fine to deal with it tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 我在电视上看到了关于朝鲜的纪录片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài diànshì shàng kàndàole guānyú Cháoxiǎn de jìlùpiàn.
examples.english: I saw a documentary about North Korea on TV.

examples.hanzi: 朝鲜族人爱吃冷面和泡菜。
examples.pinyin: Cháoxiǎnzú rén ài chī lěngmiàn hé pàocài.
examples.english: Korean ethnic people love eating cold noodles and kimchi.

examples.hanzi: 山上的空气比城里清新多了。
examples.pinyin: Shān shàng de kōngqì bǐ chéng lǐ qīngxīn duō le.
examples.english: The air up in the mountains is much fresher than in the city.

examples.hanzi: 山上有一座很古老的寺庙。
examples.pinyin: Shān shàng yǒu yí zuò hěn gǔlǎo de sìmiào.
examples.english: There is a very old temple on the mountain.

examples.hanzi: 他手腕上戴着一块旧手表。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǒuwàn shàng dàizhe yí kuài jiù shǒubiǎo.
examples.english: He wears an old watch on his wrist.

examples.hanzi: 这位经理很有手腕,能让大家都满意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jīnglǐ hěn yǒu shǒuwàn, néng ràng dàjiā dōu mǎnyì.
examples.english: This manager is very skillful at handling people and keeps everyone satisfied.

examples.hanzi: 这只鸟最明显的特征是红色的尾巴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī niǎo zuì míngxiǎn de tèzhēng shì hóngsè de wěiba.
examples.english: The most obvious feature of this bird is its red tail.

examples.hanzi: 你能描述一下那个人的外貌特征吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng miáoshù yíxià nàge rén de wàimào tèzhēng ma?
examples.english: Can you describe that person's physical features?

examples.hanzi: 我明年大学毕业前要去医院实习。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngnián dàxué bìyè qián yào qù yīyuàn shíxí.
examples.english: Before I graduate from college next year, I have to do an internship at a hospital.

examples.hanzi: 学生们在工厂里实习了一个月。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshengmen zài gōngchǎng lǐ shíxíle yí gè yuè.
examples.english: The students did a one-month internship in a factory.

examples.hanzi: 我昨晚睡眠不好,今天没精神。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuówǎn shuìmián bù hǎo, jīntiān méi jīngshén.
examples.english: I didn't sleep well last night and have no energy today.

examples.hanzi: 手机进入睡眠模式后,屏幕就黑了。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī jìnrù shuìmián móshì hòu, píngmù jiù hēi le.
examples.english: After the phone enters sleep mode, the screen goes dark.

examples.hanzi: 我只知道他的网名,不知道他的真名。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ zhīdào tā de wǎngmíng, bù zhīdào tā de zhēnmíng.
examples.english: I only know his online name, not his real name.

examples.hanzi: 这位演员用的是艺名,真名没人知道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yǎnyuán yòng de shì yìmíng, zhēnmíng méi rén zhīdào.
examples.english: This actor uses a stage name, and nobody knows his real name.

examples.hanzi: 我想在网上购买一台新电脑。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài wǎngshàng gòumǎi yì tái xīn diànnǎo.
examples.english: I'd like to buy a new computer online.

examples.hanzi: 购买这张票需要出示身份证。
examples.pinyin: Gòumǎi zhè zhāng piào xūyào chūshì shēnfènzhèng.
examples.english: You need to show your ID card to buy this ticket.

examples.hanzi: 地震后,居民们陷入了恐慌。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu, jūmínmen xiànrùle kǒnghuāng.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the residents fell into a panic.

examples.hanzi: 大家不要恐慌,保持冷静。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā bú yào kǒnghuāng, bǎochí lěngjìng.
examples.english: Everyone, don't panic; stay calm.

examples.hanzi: 这个人以前有前科,警察一直盯着他。
examples.pinyin: Zhège rén yǐqián yǒu qiánkē, jǐngchá yìzhí dīngzhe tā.
examples.english: This man has a criminal record, and the police have kept an eye on him.

examples.hanzi: 有前科的人也应该有重新开始的机会。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu qiánkē de rén yě yīnggāi yǒu chóngxīn kāishǐ de jīhuì.
examples.english: People with a record should also have a chance to start over.

examples.hanzi: 他总是忽视老师给他的建议。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì hūshì lǎoshī gěi tā de jiànyì.
examples.english: He always overlooks the advice his teacher gives him.

examples.hanzi: 这个小问题不能被忽视。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo wèntí bù néng bèi hūshì.
examples.english: This small problem can't be ignored.

examples.hanzi: 我学了一年英语,听力提升得很快。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xuéle yì nián Yīngyǔ, tīnglì tíshēng de hěn kuài.
examples.english: I've studied English for a year, and my listening has improved quickly.

examples.hanzi: 他因为工作出色,被提升为经理。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi gōngzuò chūsè, bèi tíshēng wéi jīnglǐ.
examples.english: He was promoted to manager because of his excellent work.

examples.hanzi: 这个水龙头是感应式的,手一伸过去就出水。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shuǐlóngtóu shì gǎnyìng shì de, shǒu yì shēn guòqù jiù chūshuǐ.
examples.english: This faucet is sensor-based and water comes out as soon as you reach a hand over.

examples.hanzi: 手机的感应不太灵敏。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī de gǎnyìng bú tài língmǐn.
examples.english: The phone's sensor isn't very sensitive.

examples.hanzi: 我的前任同事现在在另一家公司工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánrèn tóngshì xiànzài zài lìng yì jiā gōngsī gōngzuò.
examples.english: My former colleague now works at another company.

examples.hanzi: 他很少提起自己的前任。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn shǎo tíqǐ zìjǐ de qiánrèn.
examples.english: He seldom mentions his ex.

examples.hanzi: 我迫不及待想告诉你这个好消息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ pòbùjídài xiǎng gàosu nǐ zhège hǎo xiāoxi.
examples.english: I can't wait to tell you this good news.

examples.hanzi: 他迫不及待地打开了信。
examples.pinyin: Tā pòbùjídài de dǎkāile xìn.
examples.english: He eagerly opened the letter.

examples.hanzi: 她的歌声很甜,大家都爱听。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gēshēng hěn tián, dàjiā dōu ài tīng.
examples.english: Her singing voice is sweet, and everyone loves to hear it.

examples.hanzi: 远处传来了孩子们的歌声。
examples.pinyin: Yuǎnchù chuánláile háizimen de gēshēng.
examples.english: The sound of children singing came from afar.

examples.hanzi: 老虎是一种很危险的大型动物。
examples.pinyin: Lǎohǔ shì yì zhǒng hěn wēixiǎn de dàxíng dòngwù.
examples.english: The tiger is a very dangerous large animal.

examples.hanzi: 我属老虎,你属什么?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shǔ lǎohǔ, nǐ shǔ shénme?
examples.english: I was born in the year of the tiger; what about you?

examples.hanzi: 议会通过了新的教育法。
examples.pinyin: Yìhuì tōngguòle xīn de jiàoyù fǎ.
examples.english: Parliament passed the new education law.

examples.hanzi: 他当选为议会的议员。
examples.pinyin: Tā dāngxuǎn wéi yìhuì de yìyuán.
examples.english: He was elected a member of parliament.

examples.hanzi: 这场大火烧了三个小时才被扑灭。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dàhuǒ shāole sān gè xiǎoshí cái bèi pūmiè.
examples.english: This big fire burned for three hours before it was put out.

examples.hanzi: 大火过后,村子变成了一片废墟。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuǒ guòhòu, cūnzi biànchéngle yí piàn fèixū.
examples.english: After the great fire, the village turned into ruins.

examples.hanzi: 我不想卷入你们之间的争吵。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng juǎnrù nǐmen zhījiān de zhēngchǎo.
examples.english: I don't want to get dragged into your quarrel.

examples.hanzi: 小船被卷入了大海的漩涡。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎochuán bèi juǎnrùle dàhǎi de xuánwō.
examples.english: The small boat was swept into the whirlpool of the sea.

examples.hanzi: 我家的小狗叫蛋蛋,特别可爱。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de xiǎo gǒu jiào Dàndàn, tèbié kě'ài.
examples.english: Our puppy is called Dandan, and it's especially cute.

examples.hanzi: 妈妈叫他蛋蛋,是因为他小时候圆圆的。
examples.pinyin: Māma jiào tā Dàndàn, shì yīnwèi tā xiǎoshíhou yuányuán de.
examples.english: Mom calls him Dandan because he was round as a child.

examples.hanzi: 你弄坏了他的手机,应该赔偿。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ nònghuàile tā de shǒujī, yīnggāi péicháng.
examples.english: You broke his phone, so you should compensate him.

examples.hanzi: 航空公司赔偿了乘客的损失。
examples.pinyin: Hángkōng gōngsī péichángle chéngkè de sǔnshī.
examples.english: The airline compensated the passengers for their losses.

examples.hanzi: 我们打算明年夏天去学潜水。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn míngnián xiàtiān qù xué qiánshuǐ.
examples.english: We plan to go learn to dive next summer.

examples.hanzi: 我平时在论坛上只看帖子,很少说话,就是潜水。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngshí zài lùntán shàng zhǐ kàn tiězi, hěn shǎo shuōhuà, jiùshì qiánshuǐ.
examples.english: I usually only read posts on the forum and rarely speak; I just lurk.

examples.hanzi: 故事里的巫师念着咒语,变出了一只兔子。
examples.pinyin: Gùshi lǐ de wūshī niànzhe zhòuyǔ, biànchūle yì zhī tùzi.
examples.english: In the story, the wizard recited a spell and conjured up a rabbit.

examples.hanzi: 这个咒语好像对他一点用也没有。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhòuyǔ hǎoxiàng duì tā yìdiǎn yòng yě méiyǒu.
examples.english: This spell doesn't seem to work on him at all.

examples.hanzi: 他们周末租了一艘游艇出海。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zhōumò zūle yì sōu yóutǐng chūhǎi.
examples.english: They rented a yacht to go out to sea this weekend.

examples.hanzi: 码头上停着好几艘白色的游艇。
examples.pinyin: Mǎtou shàng tíngzhe hǎo jǐ sōu báisè de yóutǐng.
examples.english: Several white yachts were moored at the dock.

examples.hanzi: 我有个念头,想辞职去旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu gè niàntou, xiǎng cízhí qù lǚxíng.
examples.english: I have an idea of quitting my job to travel.

examples.hanzi: 他打消了去国外读书的念头。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎxiāole qù guówài dúshū de niàntou.
examples.english: He gave up the idea of studying abroad.

examples.hanzi: 我走得很快,终于甩掉了跟着我的小狗。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu de hěn kuài, zhōngyú shuǎidiàole gēnzhe wǒ de xiǎogǒu.
examples.english: I walked fast and finally shook off the puppy that was following me.

examples.hanzi: 他想甩掉身上的泥巴,就用力抖了抖衣服。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng shuǎidiào shēnshang de níbā, jiù yònglì dǒule dǒu yīfu.
examples.english: He wanted to shake off the mud, so he shook his clothes hard.

examples.hanzi: 这些药品要放在小孩拿不到的地方。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē yàopǐn yào fàng zài xiǎohái ná bú dào de dìfang.
examples.english: Keep these medicines where children can't reach them.

examples.hanzi: 进口药品需要通过检查才能销售。
examples.pinyin: Jìnkǒu yàopǐn xūyào tōngguò jiǎnchá cái néng xiāoshòu.
examples.english: Imported drugs must pass inspection before they can be sold.

examples.hanzi: 这部老电影讲的是一次暗杀行动。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù lǎo diànyǐng jiǎng de shì yí cì ànshā xíngdòng.
examples.english: This old film is about an assassination plot.

examples.hanzi: 历史书里写了那位首相被暗杀的经过。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐshū lǐ xiěle nà wèi shǒuxiàng bèi ànshā de jīngguò.
examples.english: The history book tells how that prime minister was assassinated.

examples.hanzi: 你去银行办事,别忘了带身份证。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù yínháng bànshì, bié wàngle dài shēnfènzhèng.
examples.english: When you go to the bank to take care of business, don't forget your ID card.

examples.hanzi: 他办事很认真,大家都信任他。
examples.pinyin: Tā bànshì hěn rènzhēn, dàjiā dōu xìnrèn tā.
examples.english: He works very conscientiously, and everyone trusts him.

examples.hanzi: 这个班的男生和女生一起做游戏,没有异性的隔阂。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bān de nánshēng hé nǚshēng yìqǐ zuò yóuxì, méiyǒu yìxìng de gémó.
examples.english: Boys and girls in this class play together without any barrier between the sexes.

examples.hanzi: 同性相斥,异性相吸,这是一种说法。
examples.pinyin: Tóngxìng xiāng chì, yìxìng xiāng xī, zhè shì yì zhǒng shuōfǎ.
examples.english: Same sexes repel and opposite sexes attract; that's one saying.

examples.hanzi: 能当上班长,我觉得很光荣。
examples.pinyin: Néng dāngshàng bānzhǎng, wǒ juéde hěn guāngróng.
examples.english: I feel honored to have become the class monitor.

examples.hanzi: 爷爷光荣地退休了,大家为他鼓掌。
examples.pinyin: Yéye guāngróng de tuìxiū le, dàjiā wèi tā gǔzhǎng.
examples.english: Grandpa retired with honor, and everyone applauded him.

examples.hanzi: 你这个小鬼,又在偷吃糖!
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhège xiǎoguǐ, yòu zài tōu chī táng!
examples.english: You little rascal, sneaking sweets again!

examples.hanzi: 小鬼,你今年几岁了?
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoguǐ, nǐ jīnnián jǐ suì le?
examples.english: Hey kid, how old are you this year?

examples.hanzi: 愿上天赐予你幸福和健康。
examples.pinyin: Yuàn shàngtiān cìyǔ nǐ xìngfú hé jiànkāng.
examples.english: May heaven grant you happiness and health.

examples.hanzi: 大自然赐予我们丰富的资源。
examples.pinyin: Dàzìrán cìyǔ wǒmen fēngfù de zīyuán.
examples.english: Nature has granted us abundant resources.

examples.hanzi: 他说话很有逻辑,让人容易听懂。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn yǒu luóji, ràng rén róngyì tīngdǒng.
examples.english: He speaks with good logic, so he's easy to follow.

examples.hanzi: 这个故事的逻辑有点乱,我看不明白。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gùshi de luóji yǒudiǎn luàn, wǒ kàn bù míngbai.
examples.english: The logic of this story is a bit confused and I can't make sense of it.

examples.hanzi: 这样做违背了我们的约定。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò wéibèile wǒmen de yuēdìng.
examples.english: Doing it this way goes against our agreement.

examples.hanzi: 他从来不愿违背自己的良心。
examples.pinyin: Tā cónglái bú yuàn wéibèi zìjǐ de liángxīn.
examples.english: He's never willing to go against his conscience.

examples.hanzi: 就在那一瞬间,灯全灭了。
examples.pinyin: Jiù zài nà yí shùnjiān, dēng quán miè le.
examples.english: In that very instant, all the lights went out.

examples.hanzi: 时间过得真快,一瞬间孩子就长大了。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài, yí shùnjiān háizi jiù zhǎng dà le.
examples.english: Time flies; in a blink the child has grown up.

examples.hanzi: 他是个酒鬼,每天晚上都喝醉。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè jiǔguǐ, měitiān wǎnshang dōu hēzuì.
examples.english: He's a drunkard who gets drunk every night.

examples.hanzi: 别当酒鬼,喝酒对身体不好。
examples.pinyin: Bié dāng jiǔguǐ, hē jiǔ duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
examples.english: Don't become a drunkard; drinking is bad for your health.

examples.hanzi: 我们要找个正经的工作,不能总是玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhǎo gè zhèngjing de gōngzuò, bù néng zǒngshì wán.
examples.english: We need to find a proper job and can't just play all the time.

examples.hanzi: 他一脸正经地说:“我不是开玩笑。”
examples.pinyin: Tā yì liǎn zhèngjing de shuō: "Wǒ bú shì kāi wánxiào."
examples.english: He said with a straight face, "I'm not joking."

examples.hanzi: 奶奶去世后,给我们留下了一些遗产。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai qùshì hòu, gěi wǒmen liúxiàle yìxiē yíchǎn.
examples.english: After Grandma passed away, she left us some inheritance.

examples.hanzi: 这座古城是世界文化遗产。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng shì shìjiè wénhuà yíchǎn.
examples.english: This ancient city is a World Cultural Heritage site.

examples.hanzi: 这条高速公路通往海边。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gāosù gōnglù tōngwǎng hǎibiān.
examples.english: This highway leads to the seaside.

examples.hanzi: 哪条路通往火车站?
examples.pinyin: Nǎ tiáo lù tōngwǎng huǒchēzhàn?
examples.english: Which road leads to the train station?

examples.hanzi: 我最喜欢的科目是物理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de kēmù shì wùlǐ.
examples.english: My favorite subject is physics.

examples.hanzi: 这是一个物理现象,不是魔术。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yí gè wùlǐ xiànxiàng, bú shì móshù.
examples.english: This is a physical phenomenon, not magic.

examples.hanzi: 别上当,这是骗子设下的圈套。
examples.pinyin: Bié shàngdàng, zhè shì piànzi shèxià de quāntào.
examples.english: Don't be fooled; this is a trap set by a scammer.

examples.hanzi: 他设了个圈套,想让对方说出真话。
examples.pinyin: Tā shèle gè quāntào, xiǎng ràng duìfāng shuōchū zhēnhuà.
examples.english: He set a trap, hoping to get the other person to tell the truth.

examples.hanzi: 这块肥皂有一股淡淡的花香。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài féizào yǒu yì gǔ dàndàn de huāxiāng.
examples.english: This bar of soap has a faint floral scent.

examples.hanzi: 浴室里没有肥皂了,我去买一块。
examples.pinyin: Yùshì lǐ méiyǒu féizào le, wǒ qù mǎi yí kuài.
examples.english: There's no soap in the bathroom, so I'll go buy a bar.
